[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-af[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Lane-level runner-slot gating for AXE lumberjacks[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Every agent an AXE lumberjack launches from a script chop proposal [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]carries a `%wait(runners=N)` directive taken from a new [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]`axe.lumberjacks.<name>.wait_runners` config key, so the [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]`code_quality` lane can be configured to hold its audit agents [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]until the machine is quiet instead of competing with ordinary work [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]for the global runner pool.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plans:202607/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]lumberjack_wait_runners.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Rust core accepts the lumberjack wait_runners key[/bold #D7AFFF]             [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]core_wait_runners[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]core_wait_runners: add `wait_runners` to `LUMBERJACK_KEYS` in [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]sase-core's AXE validator, validate it as a non-negative integer with a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]new `validate_nonnegative_integer` helper, and cover accept/reject cases[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]in the axe_chop unit tests and the config parity suite.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Plumb wait_runners through sase and inject the directive[/bold #D7AFFF]      [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]sase_plumbing[dim] · [dim][/dim]after core_wait_runners[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]sase_plumbing: add `wait_runners` to `LumberjackConfig`, parse it, add [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]it to the bundled JSON schema and the AXE entry editor basics, thread it[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]from the lumberjack down to `prepare_chop_proposals`, emit the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`%wait(runners=N)` line from `scaffolded_prompt` unless the proposal [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]already declares one, show it in `sase axe lumberjack list`, and cover [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]it with tests and docs.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Require the published core and turn the lane on[/bold #D7AFFF]               [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]enable_code_quality[dim] · [dim][/dim]after sase_plumbing[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]enable_code_quality: bump the `sase-core-rs` window in pyproject.toml to[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the release that carries the Rust change, then set `wait_runners` on the[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`code_quality` lumberjack in the chezmoi-managed sase_athena.yml.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
